defects.description: The AIMS360 wordmark is much larger and heavier than the neighbouring logos (ApparelMagic, InStyle, BlueCherry). The baseline shows it at a similar scale to ApparelMagic with a light weight, so here it dominates its cell and looks like a different treatment.
The 'In-Style Software' sub-caption beside the InStyle! logo is tiny and hard to read on paper. The logo is also small relative to AIMS360.
The BlueCherry logo and its 'by CGS' tag are small compared with the Aptean and AIMS360 logos. This makes the top-left quadrant feel sparse and the logo sizes uneven.
ApparelMagic sits very close to the AIMS360 logo, and its gap to AIMS360 is tighter than the spacing in the baseline. The pair also sits lower than the baseline's bottom-right quadrant placement.
The 'Our take' block runs to the right edge with tight wrapping. The bottom-left quadrant holds only one logo while the bottom-right holds two, so the chart looks unbalanced.

vision.summary: Slides 1 and 2 match the baseline with no visible defects. Slide 3 has one major defect: the AIMS360 logo is far larger and heavier than the other competitor logos. The remaining slide 3 issues are minor logo sizing and spacing problems.
